checkpoint_review: The Router was generally accurate but slightly too lenient on the 'Dark suit' checkpoint. While it correctly marked it as false, it treated it as a simple attribute mismatch. However, given the taxonomy explicitly states 'typically wearing a dark suit', the presence of a white suit is a significant deviation from the prior, though not necessarily a class failure (white tuxedos are valid for grooms). The Router correctly identified untestable checkpoints (shoes, small accessories) due to cropping/resolution. I agree with all verdicts, but emphasize that the 'Dark suit' failure is a notable semantic deviation.
artifact_review: The Router underestimated the severity of the structural issues indicated by the Pose Auditor. The Router noted 'structural_collapse' at severity 1.0 for the hands, but the Pose Auditor returned an 'HIGH' artifact risk level with 88% low-confidence keypoints. While some of this is due to domain shift (AI image vs real photo training data), the extremely low confidence in facial features (eyes, ears) and shoulders suggests the model struggled to define the subject's geometry against the bright flash and complex background. The Topology Auditor's mask confidence of 0.82 is borderline, indicating some boundary ambiguity. I am upgrading the artifact severity to reflect this widespread geometric uncertainty, even if visually subtle.
alignment_reasoning: The Fine Grained Classifier strongly confirms the class 'groom' (Top-1 logit 6.9), overriding the 'dark suit' checkpoint failure. White tuxedos are a valid, albeit less common, variation of the groom class. Most other visible checkpoints (hair, bow tie, posture) are present. The alignment is good, but the deviation from the 'typical' dark suit prior prevents a perfect score.
artifact_reasoning: The Pose Auditor flagged HIGH risk (88% low-confidence keypoints), particularly in the face and limbs. While the Perceptual Quality Auditor found only slight darkening/blur, the geometric uncertainty is significant. The bright flash causes edge bleeding and makes precise anatomical definition difficult (evidenced by the low pose confidence). The hand-kissing gesture area is visually ambiguous, supporting the Router's observation of minor structural collapse. The image is not catastrophic, but the lack of crisp structural definition lowers the artifact score below the 'clean' reference range.
key_defects: Deviation from typical 'dark suit' attire (wearing white)
High geometric uncertainty in pose estimation (88% low-confidence keypoints)
Ambiguous hand/finger anatomy during hand-kissing gesture
Boundary softness due to strong backlight/flash glare
